'''Chloride''' was a [[Color/Legends|green]] substance that, along with [[Ozone/Legends|ozone]] and [[Sulfur/Legends|sulfur]]-colored clouds, was visible in flashes in the sky over [[Eriadu City/Legends|Eriadu City]], the [[Capital/Legends|capital]] of the [[Outer Rim Territories/Legends|Outer Rim Territories]] [[Planet/Legends|planet]] [[Eriadu/Legends|Eriadu]].<ref name="GatORW" />
